One new full fit plus its finite three-rule panel is one independent unit. Average 64 paired world differences within each unit, then weight all five unit means equally. Both lower bounds strictly above .01 are required jointly. A one-comparator pass supports only that qualified component; a crossing interval leaves the practical margin unresolved; an upper bound at/below .01 weighs against that component's target, and an upper bound below zero is stronger adverse evidence under the same model. A within-margin point is not equivalence; all adverse/extreme units remain. Keep dwell-C secondary.
